card.title: 756th REGIMENT
card.text: When this unit attacks and destroys a unit, deal excess damage to the enemy HQ.
card.flavorText: The 756th Regiment was part of the 150th Rifle Division. It was formed in 1939 and participated in the invasion of Poland. During the war on the Eastern Front it fought in many places, always distinguishing itself and was regarded as an elite force. It was given the honorific title of “Idritskaya” in July 1944 for its heroic battle in the town of Idritsa. But it most famous moment was being the unit that raised the Soviet banner on the roof of the Reichstag in Berlin in April 1945.
